items.condition: The submission uses a different composition, atom identity, charge, or crystal input without identifying and justifying the change.
No convergence evidence or reproducibility metadata is supplied for a claimed completed calculation.
DOS/ELF claims are made without a submitted data/map artifact or without binding observations to named energy regions or atoms.
The final conclusion asserts a unique mechanism, exact numerical agreement or experimental fact not supported by the submitted calculations and source-defined scope.
